gloss: absolutely; by no means; without exception

definitions.gloss: absolutely not; by no means (with a negative)
definitions.explanation: Used with a negative predicate to deny something flatly and with conviction. This is by far the more common pattern.

definitions.gloss: absolutely; without fail; come what may (with an affirmative)
definitions.explanation: Used with an affirmative predicate to declare firm resolve. Formal and emphatic, common in speeches and written declarations.

examples.english: I will absolutely not allow it.

examples.japanese: そんな{事実|じじつ}は{断|だん}じてない。
examples.english: There is absolutely no such fact.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{断|だん}じてそのような{発言|はつげん}をしておりません。
examples.english: I have absolutely never made any such statement.

examples.japanese: {断|だん}じて{実行|じっこう}する。
examples.english: I will carry it out, no matter what.

examples.japanese: {断|だん}じてやり{遂|と}げる{覚悟|かくご}です。
examples.english: I am resolved to see it through to the end.

examples.japanese: {断|だん}じて{行|おこな}えば{鬼神|きしん}もこれを{避|さ}ける、という{言葉|ことば}がある。
examples.english: There is a saying that if you act with resolve, even demons will get out of your way.

notes:
The te-form of the classical {断|だん}ずる (to decide, to judge), fossilized as an adverb. Formal and emphatic; in casual speech {絶対|ぜったい} does the same work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断|だん}じて{許|ゆる}さない: will absolutely not tolerate
- {断|だん}じて{認|みと}めない: absolutely refuse to acknowledge
- {断|だん}じてない: absolutely not so
- {断|だん}じて{行|おこな}う: to act with full resolve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絶対|ぜったい}に: absolutely — everyday equivalent, works with both polarities
- {決|けっ}して: never — negative only, neutral in register and more common in writing
- {断固|だんこ}として: resolutely, firmly — about the manner of acting, usually affirmative
